name: Greenspace Health
short_description: Measurement-based care platform that sends, scores and tracks validated measures across a clinic, with EHR integrations and reporting.
long_description: Greenspace automates delivery, scoring and aggregation of validated mental-health measures, with progress views for clinicians and outcome reporting for practice leaders. One monthly fee per clinic account covers unlimited therapists; pricing is by quote. It lists integrations with EHRs including Qualifacts, Netsmart myAvatar, Welligent and Epic. The company publishes a provider BAA and reports annual SOC 2 Type 2 examinations. Founded in 2015 out of St. Michael's Hospital, Toronto; serves the US and Canada.
one_liner: Clinic-wide measurement-based care with outcome reporting, priced per clinic.
best_for: Group practices that want one clinic fee covering unlimited therapists
Practice leaders who need outcome reporting across clinicians
Groups on Qualifacts, Netsmart, Welligent or Epic that need EHR integration
Practices billing CPT 96127 that need scored measures documented
not_for: Solo clinicians who want a self-serve, published-price plan
SimplePractice users who need a documented integration
Buyers who want to start a trial without a sales call

seo.title: Greenspace Health: Enterprise MBC Platform | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Greenspace Health offers 300+ evidence-based assessments with 85+ EHR integrations. 3.5x better outcomes. HIPAA compliant MBC for behavioral health...

faqs.q: How many assessments does Greenspace Health offer?
faqs.a: Greenspace Health offers over 300 evidence-based assessments including PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5, AUDIT, and many more. The Basic plan includes 18 assessments, with full library access on higher tiers.

faqs.q: What EHR systems does Greenspace integrate with?
faqs.a: Greenspace integrates with 85+ EHR/EMR systems including Epic, Oracle Cerner, Meditech, Netsmart, Athenahealth, AdvancedMD, and NextGen using FHIR, HL7, and open APIs.

faqs.q: What is the assessment completion rate with Greenspace?
faqs.a: Greenspace achieves an 83% average assessment completion rate across implementations, significantly higher than paper-based or manual assessment approaches.

faqs.q: Is Greenspace HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Greenspace Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and also compliant with PIPEDA and PHIPA for Canadian customers.
